fullDescription: A friendly, light-mode card-grid FAQ section on a warm cream marketing page: a sticky frosted-cream nav, then a centered header (a 'Help center' eyebrow pill, a big two-line 'Questions, answered the friendly way.' heading with a coral period, and a soft lead) over three pale blurred color blobs, then a responsive 1 / 2 / 3-column grid of rounded-4xl white FAQ cards. Each card is a native <details> disclosure with a circular toggle (sky-blue plus that flips to a coral minus when open) and a smooth grid-template-rows height reveal; open cards lift on a sky-tinted shadow and glow border. Closes with a dark-navy gradient CTA strip ('Can't find your answer?' + a white 'Chat with us' button and a ghost 'Browse the docs' button, over soft coral/sky glows) and a light social footer. Poppins font, cream #fdf9f3 ground, sky #38bdf8 + coral #fb7185 accents, ink #1f2433 text, Iconify Solar icons.

A sticky frosted-cream top nav (a sky-to-coral gradient rounded sparkle logo + a 'Promptly.' wordmark with a sky period, a row of nav links with the active 'FAQ' link in ink, a ghost 'Sign in' link and a solid ink 'Start free' pill) sits above a centered section header: a sky 'Help center' eyebrow pill, a big two-line 'Questions, answered the friendly way.' heading whose final period is coral, and a soft muted lead. Three large pale blurred color blobs (sky and coral) float behind the header. Beneath it, a responsive grid of rounded-4xl white FAQ cards (1 column on mobile, 2 on tablet, 3 on desktop): each card is a native HTML
disclosure whose shows the question and a circular toggle, and whose answer reveals with a smooth grid-template-rows height animation. The toggle is a sky-blue circle with a plus icon that, when the card is open, turns coral and swaps to a minus; open cards also lift slightly and gain a sky-tinted glow shadow and border, while hover nudges every card up 3px. The first two cards are open by default; the remaining seven start closed. A full-width dark-navy gradient CTA strip ('Can't find your answer?' with a white 'Chat with us' button and a ghost 'Browse the docs' button, over soft coral and sky blurred glows) and a light social footer anchor the page. ` is `sticky top-0 z-50 bg-cream/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-ink/5` with its content centered in a `mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 lg:px-10` row at `h-[72px]`: a brand cluster on the left (a sky-to-coral gradient `rounded-2xl` sparkle logo chip + a 'Promptly.' wordmark with a sky period), a `hidden md:flex` row of nav links (Gallery / Library / Pricing, plus an active ink 'FAQ' link), and a right cluster (a `hidden sm:block` ghost 'Sign in' link + a solid ink `rounded-full` 'Start free' pill). The FAQ header `
` is `relative overflow-hidden` with three absolutely-positioned blurred blobs behind a centered `mx-auto max-w-2xl pt-20 pb-12 text-center md:pt-28 md:pb-16` stack: a sky 'Help center' eyebrow pill, the two-line 'Questions, answered the friendly way.' heading (final period coral), and a muted lead. The grid `
` centers a `mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 pb-8 lg:px-10` wrapper holding `grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3` with nine `
` cards (the first two `open`). Each card is `rounded-4xl border border-ink/5 bg-white p-7 shadow-card` with a `` (question `

` + circular toggle) and a `.faq-answer` grid-collapse wrapper holding the answer `

`. The CTA `

` centers a `rounded-5xl bg-gradient-to-br from-ink to-[#0c1a3a]` card with two blurred glows, a white heading + lead, and a button row (a white 'Chat with us' button with a coral chat icon + a ghost 'Browse the docs' button). The `
` is `border-t border-ink/5 bg-white` with a centered `max-w-7xl` row of brand / link row / copyright. Below lg the grid steps to 2 then 1 column; below md the nav links hide and the footer reflows to a stacked column.

LEFT: a brand anchor `flex items-center gap-2.5` = a `grid h-9 w-9 place-items-center rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-sky to-coral text-white shadow-pill` chip holding a 20px `solar:magic-stick-3-bold` Iconify icon + a `text-[19px] font-700 tracking-tight` 'Promptly' wordmark whose trailing period is a `text-sky` span. CENTER-RIGHT: a `hidden md:flex items-center gap-9` `<nav>` of links Gallery / Library / Pricing (each `text-[15px] font-500 text-slate2 transition hover:text-ink`) plus an active `text-[15px] font-600 text-ink` 'FAQ' link to #faq. RIGHT: a `flex items-center gap-3` cluster = a `hidden sm:block text-[15px] font-500 text-slate2 transition hover:text-ink` 'Sign in' ghost link + a solid `rounded-full bg-ink px-5 py-2.5 text-[14px] font-600 text-white transition hover:bg-ink/90` 'Start free' pill.

prompts.partPt: Dark gradient Chamada Final para Ação strip
prompts.prompt: Build `<section class="relative px-6 py-16 lg:px-10">` with an inner `<div class="mx-auto max-w-7xl">` holding a `<div class="relative overflow-hidden rounded-5xl bg-gradient-to-br from-ink to-[#0c1a3a] px-8 py-12 text-center md:px-16 md:py-16">`. Behind the content place two `pointer-events-none absolute` blurred glows: a `-right-10 -top-10 h-48 w-48 rounded-full bg-coral/40 blur-xl` and a `-bottom-12 -left-8 h-56 w-56 rounded-full bg-sky/25 blur-xl`. Then a `relative` content block: an `<h2 class="text-[28px] font-800 leading-tight text-white md:text-[36px]">` 'Can't find your answer?', a `mx-auto mt-3 max-w-md text-[16px] leading-relaxed text-white` lead, and a `mt-8 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 sm:flex-row` button row = a solid `inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-white px-7 py-3.5 text-[15px] font-700 text-ink shadow-card transition hover:-translate-y-0.5` 'Chat with us' button with a 20px `solar:chat-round-dots-bold` icon styled `color:#fb7185`, plus a ghost `inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-white/70 bg-white/10 px-7 py-3.5 text-[15px] font-600 text-white transition hover:bg-white/20` 'Browse the docs' button.

Close the page with `<footer class="border-t border-ink/5 bg-white">` wrapping a `mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 py-10 lg:px-10` row that is `flex flex-col items-center justify-between gap-6 sm:flex-row`. LEFT: a `flex items-center gap-2.5` brand cluster = a `grid h-8 w-8 place-items-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-sky to-coral text-white` chip with a 17px `solar:magic-stick-3-bold` icon + a `text-[16px] font-700 tracking-tight` 'Promptly' wordmark with a `text-sky` period. CENTER: a `flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-x-7 gap-y-2 text-[14px] font-500 text-slate2` link row (Gallery / Library / Pricing / Changelog, each `transition hover:text-ink`). RIGHT: a `text-[13px] text-slate2` copyright '© 2026 Promptly. Made with care.'. Below sm the row stacks to a centered column.

Use the native HTML `<details>`/`<summary>` element for each card (no JS needed for open/close). Kill the default disclosure marker: `.faq summary { list-style: none }`, `.faq summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none }`, and `.faq summary::marker { content: "" }` (do NOT set `display` on the summary in CSS so Tailwind's `.flex` utility still wins). Toggle the two icons by open state: `.faq .faq-icon-minus { display: none }`, `.faq[open] .faq-icon-plus { display: none }`, `.faq[open] .faq-icon-minus { display: inline-block }`. On open, recolor the toggle to coral with the coral pill shadow: `.faq[open] .faq-toggle { background-color: #fb7185; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -8px rgba(251,113,133,0.55) }`, and promote the whole card: `.faq[open] { box-shadow: 0 22px 50px -18px rgba(56,189,248,0.40); border-color: rgba(56,189,248,0.45) }`. The first two cards carry the `open` attribute so they render expanded by default.

The grid is `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3`: one column on mobile, two at md, three at lg. The nav links row is `hidden md:flex` (collapsing below md to just the brand + 'Start free' pill), and the 'Sign in' ghost link is `hidden sm:block`. The heading scales from `text-[40px]` up to `md:text-[56px]` and its line break (`<br class="hidden sm:block">`) only appears at sm+. The header padding eases from `pt-20 pb-12` to `md:pt-28 md:pb-16`, and the CTA strip padding from `px-8 py-12` to `md:px-16 md:py-16`. The CTA button row is `flex-col` on mobile and `sm:flex-row` above. The footer is `flex-col` (centered) on mobile and `sm:flex-row` (brand left, links center, copyright right) above. All three main sections share a `max-w-7xl` width with matching `px-6 lg:px-10` gutters.

special_ui_components.prompt: Each FAQ card is a native HTML `<details class="faq rounded-4xl border border-ink/5 bg-white p-7 shadow-card">` whose `<summary>` is the clickable question row and whose following `.faq-answer` wrapper holds the answer, so open/close works with zero JavaScript. Suppress the browser's default disclosure triangle with `.faq summary { list-style:none }`, `.faq summary::-webkit-details-marker { display:none }`, and `.faq summary::marker { content:"" }`, but deliberately avoid setting `display` on the summary in CSS so the Tailwind `.flex` utility keeps controlling the summary layout. The first two cards carry the `open` attribute to render expanded by default.

The toggle is a circular `.faq-toggle` (`grid h-9 w-9 flex-none place-items-center rounded-full bg-sky text-white transition`) holding two stacked Iconify Solar icons: a `solar:add-circle-linear` plus (`.faq-icon-plus`) and a `solar:minus-circle-linear` minus (`.faq-icon-minus`). By default the minus is hidden; when the parent card is `[open]` the plus hides and the minus shows (`.faq .faq-icon-minus { display:none }`, `.faq[open] .faq-icon-plus { display:none }`, `.faq[open] .faq-icon-minus { display:inline-block }`), and the circle recolors from sky-blue to coral with a coral pill shadow (`.faq[open] .faq-toggle { background-color:#fb7185; box-shadow:0 8px 20px -8px rgba(251,113,133,0.55) }`). So a closed card reads sky-plus and an open card reads coral-minus.

The answer reveal avoids the max-height hack: each `.faq-answer` is `display:grid; grid-template-rows:0fr; transition: grid-template-rows .35s ease`, and its direct child `
` is `overflow:hidden`. When the parent `.faq` is `[open]`, the rule `.faq[open] .faq-answer { grid-template-rows:1fr }` animates the row from 0fr to 1fr, smoothly expanding to the natural content height with no JS height measurement. The answer `

` carries `pt-4` so it gains breathing room only once expanded.

Cards animate on `transition: box-shadow .3s ease, border-color .3s ease, transform .3s ease`. On hover the whole card nudges up 3px (`.faq:hover { transform: translateY(-3px) }`). On open the card swaps its base `shadow-card` (a neutral `0 10px 30px -12px rgba(31,36,51,0.12)`) for a sky-tinted glow shadow and a faint sky border: `.faq[open] { box-shadow:0 22px 50px -18px rgba(56,189,248,0.40); border-color:rgba(56,189,248,0.45) }`. Closed cards keep a hairline `border-ink/5`. This gives the open card a lifted, lit-from-behind feel that distinguishes it from its neighbours.

Depth on the flat cream ground comes from soft translucent color shapes. Behind the header, a `pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 -z-0` layer holds three `.blob` `rounded-full` shapes with `filter: blur(2px)`: an `h-72 w-72 bg-sky/20` top-left, an `h-80 w-80 bg-coral/15` mid-right, and an `h-64 w-64 bg-sky/10` bottom-center. Behind the CTA card, two `pointer-events-none absolute` Tailwind-blurred glows (`blur-xl`): a `h-48 w-48 bg-coral/40` top-right and a `h-56 w-56 bg-sky/25` bottom-left. Together they keep the cream background airy and gradient-lit rather than flat.

The page's one dark moment is the CTA strip: a `rounded-5xl bg-gradient-to-br from-ink to-[#0c1a3a]` card (deep navy gradient) dropped into the otherwise light cream page, with white text, a solid white 'Chat with us' button (a coral `solar:chat-round-dots-bold` icon, `text-ink`, lifts 0.5 on hover) and a translucent ghost 'Browse the docs' button (`border-white/70 bg-white/10`). Two soft `blur-xl` coral and sky glows sit inside it. The contrast flip (dark strip on a light page) gives the closing CTA visual weight without breaking the friendly palette.

structured.special_notes: Exact tokens (Tailwind config extend): fonts = Poppins (Google Fonts weights 400;500;600;700;800) set as `fontFamily.sans = ['Poppins','ui-sans-serif','system-ui','sans-serif']`. Colors: `cream` #fdf9f3, `sky` #38bdf8, `coral` #fb7185, `ink` #1f2433, `slate2` #5b6273; the CTA gradient runs `from-ink` (#1f2433) `to-[#0c1a3a]`; the eyebrow pill label uses inline `color:#075985`. borderRadius: `4xl` = 2rem (cards), `5xl` = 2.75rem (CTA strip). boxShadow: `card` = '0 10px 30px -12px rgba(31,36,51,0.12)', `cardhover` = '0 22px 50px -18px rgba(56,189,248,0.40)', `pill` = '0 8px 20px -8px rgba(251,113,133,0.55)'. Body `font-sans text-ink antialiased selection:bg-coral/20` with `body { background-color:#fdf9f3 }` and `html { scroll-behavior:smooth }`. Two accents only: sky (#38bdf8) and coral (#fb7185); ink/slate2 for text; structure via hairline `border-ink/5` plus the three soft shadows. Disclosure mechanics (no JS): native `<details>`/`<summary>`; kill the marker with `.faq summary { list-style:none }` + `::-webkit-details-marker { display:none }` + `::marker { content:"" }` (do NOT set `display` on summary so Tailwind `.flex` wins); icon swap `.faq .faq-icon-minus { display:none }`, `.faq[open] .faq-icon-plus { display:none }`, `.faq[open] .faq-icon-minus { display:inline-block }`. Open-card treatment: `.faq[open] .faq-toggle { background-color:#fb7185; box-shadow:0 8px 20px -8px rgba(251,113,133,0.55) }` and `.faq[open] { box-shadow:0 22px 50px -18px rgba(56,189,248,0.40); border-color:rgba(56,189,248,0.45) }`. Answer animation: `.faq-answer { display:grid; grid-template-rows:0fr; transition: grid-template-rows .35s ease }` with `.faq-answer > div { overflow:hidden }`, opening to `grid-template-rows:1fr` on `.faq[open]`. Card transitions: `transition: box-shadow .3s ease, border-color .3s ease, transform .3s ease` with `.faq:hover { transform: translateY(-3px) }`; closed-card summaries get `min-height:56px; align-items:center` via `.faq:not([open]) > summary`. Heading `text-[40px] md:text-[56px] font-800 leading-[1.08] tracking-tight` ('Questions, answered' / 'the friendly way' with a coral '.'). Card questions `text-[18px] font-700 leading-snug`; answers `text-[15px] leading-relaxed text-slate2`. Icons are Iconify Solar set (CDN https://code.iconify.design/3/3.1.1/iconify.min.js): `solar:magic-stick-3-bold` (logo), `solar:question-circle-bold` (eyebrow), `solar:add-circle-linear` / `solar:minus-circle-linear` (toggle), `solar:chat-round-dots-bold` (CTA). Layout: a sticky `bg-cream/80 backdrop-blur-md` `h-[72px]` nav over a `relative overflow-hidden` `#faq` header (three blurred blobs + a centered `max-w-2xl` eyebrow/heading/lead stack), then a centered `max-w-7xl` `grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5` of nine `<details class="faq">` cards (first two open), then a `rounded-5xl` dark-navy gradient CTA strip with two `blur-xl` glows, closed by a light `bg-white` social footer; below lg the grid steps 3->2->1, below md the nav links hide, the 'Sign in' link is `hidden sm:block`. This is an original prompt-library product for the placeholder design-tool brand 'Promptly' (faithfully reproducing the build HTML); the prompt-library value is the friendly light-mode card-grid FAQ pattern itself (a responsive grid of rounded white <details> cards with sky-to-coral plus/minus toggles and a grid-rows reveal, on a soft cream pastel ground).
